svg.aria-label: Cabling, front view of U11 and U12. The access switch SWAGGER-ACCESS-SW01 sits above a 24-port patch panel, and each panel port feeds the switch port with the same number. Port 1 admin workstation, VLAN 10. Ports 2 and 3 AP-1 and AP-2, trunks for VLANs 20 and 30. Port 4 internal workstation, VLAN 20. Ports 5 to 8 four PoE cameras and port 9 the NVR, VLAN 60. Port 10 R720 NIC1, VLAN 10. Port 11 R720 NIC2, trunk for VLANs 20 and 40. Port 12 UNAS Pro, VLAN 40. Ports 13 to 48 are shut down. Te1/0/1-2 uplink to the core as Po1. Panel ports 1 to 8 are wall runs, 9 to 12 come from devices in the rack, and 13 to 24 are spare. Cord colors follow the VLANs; trunk cords are striped.
svg.title: Cabling
